# Contributing

Small, focused changes are welcome. Open an issue first for anything that changes the public API.

- Keep the library standard-library only.
- `make fmt vet test` must pass (tests run with `-race`).
- Add a regression test with every bug fix.
- Every Go file carries the `SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0` header.

By contributing you agree your work is licensed under Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE`).
